summary: Feed s090_single is degraded due to 94.2% encrypted traffic exceeding NDR tolerance of 90%. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, packet drops, tool overload, VLANs) are healthy, but payload visibility is limited to metadata.

findings.root_cause: 94.2% of bytes are TLS-encrypted and forwarded as-is by the packet broker without decryption or key sharing. NDR is receiving ciphertext rather than cleartext payload, typical when HTTPS/TLS traffic is mirrored directly without an SSL visibility appliance.
findings.impact_on_tool: This NDR requires full payload inspection and tolerates up to 90% encrypted traffic. At 94.2% encrypted, deep packet inspection, signature matching, and anomaly detection are blinded to content, reducing detection coverage for C2, exfiltration and lateral movement to flow metadata only.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting relevant TLS sessions (or providing session keys/metadata via an SSL visibility solution) before the NDR will restore payload visibility and bring encrypted share below 90% threshold, enabling full NDR detection without violating privacy/policy.
